title: Six socks are not six possible pairs
hook: Six plain socks, three pairs, no marks. How many two-sock pairings could you try?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that six socks can be put together in 15 different pairs, so the checks grow fast with more socks, and distinct patterns cut this to one look per sock

misconception: Six loose socks need only a handful of checks to pair up.
objective: Each sock can go with any of the others, so six socks give 15 pairings: 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1. The pairings grow much faster than the socks: ten socks give 45. A mark on each pair leaves one pairing per pair.
